title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Numbers 18: the duties of the priests and Levites, the portions given to Aaron, the redemption of the firstborn and the tithe of the tithe.

questions.text: According to Yahweh, who would bear the iniquity of the sanctuary?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Aaron that he, his sons and his fathers' house with him would bear the iniquity of the sanctuary.

answers.text: Aaron, his sons and his fathers' house
The elders and the judges of Israel
All the congregation of the children of Israel
The princes of the twelve tribes

questions.text: What were the Levites not allowed to come near, so that they would not die?
questions.explanation: The tribe of Levi was joined to Aaron to keep the duty of the whole Tent, but they were not to come near the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that they not die.

answers.text: The door of the Tent of Meeting
The tents of the other tribes
The vessels of the sanctuary and the altar

questions.text: What would happen to a stranger who came near the priestly service?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "The stranger who comes near shall be put to death."

answers.text: He would be cut off for seven days
He would be put to death
He would have to pay a fine of silver

questions.text: What was the redemption price for a firstborn of man redeemed from a month old?
questions.explanation: The firstborn of man had to be redeemed, from a month old, for five shekels of money, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

questions.text: What did Yahweh say about the firstborn of a cow, a sheep or a goat?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said they must not be redeemed because they are holy; their blood was to be sprinkled on the altar and their fat burned.

answers.text: They must be redeemed for five shekels
They must not be redeemed, for they are holy
They belong to the owner's household
They must be released into the wilderness

questions.text: What is the gift of the wave offerings to Aaron and his offspring called?
questions.explanation: Yahweh called it "a covenant of salt forever before Yahweh" to Aaron and his offspring.

questions.text: What did Yahweh say would be Aaron's portion and inheritance among the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: Aaron would have no inheritance in the land; Yahweh said, "I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel."

answers.text: A double share of the land

questions.text: What did Yahweh give to the children of Levi for an inheritance?
questions.explanation: Yahweh gave all the tithe in Israel to the children of Levi for an inheritance, in return for their service at the Tent of Meeting.

questions.text: What were the Levites to offer up to Yahweh from the tithe they received?
questions.explanation: The Levites were to offer a wave offering of it for Yahweh, a tithe of the tithe, and give Yahweh's wave offering to Aaron the priest.

questions.text: After the Levites had heaved the best from their tithe, where were they allowed to eat the rest?
questions.explanation: When they had heaved its best from it, Yahweh said, "You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service."

answers.text: Only in the court of the Tent
